visual.general_description: Four color clinical photographs in a two by two grid, labelled A to D: face and shoulders, upper chest, both forearms and both hands.

A (top left) shows a gray-haired man's head and shoulders with a black bar over the eyes; B (top right) shows the bare upper chest and shoulders cropped at the chin by a face mask; C (bottom left) shows both forearms side by side on a white background; D (bottom right) shows the backs of both hands with extended fingers. Brown spots are scattered over the skin in all four panels. No other text, scale or markers are printed.

visual.general_description: Three grayscale axial chest CT slices labelled A to C, with a red arrow in B and blue and yellow arrows in C.
visual.detailed_description: Three axial chest CT images arranged with A and B in the top row and C at the lower left, separated by white gutters, each with a printed letter in parentheses at its upper left; the lower right cell is empty. A shows the upper chest with dark lungs and scattered fine linear opacities, more evident posteriorly on the image right; B shows the heart level with fine reticular opacities in the posterior and peripheral lungs and a red arrow near the chest wall on the image left; C shows a lower level with the heart and liver dome and dense lattice-like opacities at both posterior lung bases, a blue arrow on the image left and a yellow arrow on the image right. No other text is printed.

panels.general_description: Axial chest CT slice at the level of the upper chest, labelled A.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial chest CT with the printed letter (A) at the upper left. The trachea is a dark round lumen near the center with the aortic arch and mediastinum around it; both lung fields are dark with scattered fine linear opacities, which are more evident toward the posterior part of the lung on the image right. Rounded chest-wall soft tissue and a curved table line are visible around the lungs. No arrows are present and no other text is printed.

evidence.quote: Chest computed tomography demonstrated subpleural reticular pattern (red arrow), traction bronchiectasis (blue arrow), and consolidation (yellow arrow) (A–C).
